name: Pieve Ligure (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and light blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pieve Ligure (a monogram of Mary and a tower on blue with a bend of ships).
history: Municipal flag of Pieve Ligure, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Pieve Ligure arms — monogram of Mary and a tower on blue with a bend of ships
